characters.name: 荆棘莓童
characters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete full-body dark-fairytale enemy concept on plain warm gray paper, square composition with generous margins. Image 1 is exact structural reference only: low domed wide mushroom cap with 6-8 short conical projections, cap approximately 60% of total height, one plump pear-shaped body, TWO short arms and TWO short feet. Do not reuse the pointed wizard hat of other characters. Image 2 is hand-painted game style reference only. Ink contours, painterly gouache shading and restrained material texture, mild horror with a cute readable silhouette. Three-quarter SIDE combat view facing SCREEN LEFT: face on the left side of body, near eye near left silhouette, other eye smaller, right body flank visible. Do not face the viewer or right. All limbs and cap visible, no text, no panels, no detached props, no extra arms. Main silhouette should be rig-friendly and mobile-readable. An overripe cursed forest berry imp. Giant squat domed cap made of deep dusty cranberry fruit skin, several thick pale dried thorn-seeds embedded like the original conical spikes. Cap has one dark crescent split near its lower rim, with seed-like ivory kernels inside suggesting a hidden smile, but no actual eyeballs or human teeth on the cap. Small plump body pale rose-beige soft pith, two worried dark seed eyes and tiny uneven mouth, short mitten arms and tapered feet. Cute soft squashed body. Sparse charcoal vine scars and one sticky amber-black juice bead make it uncanny. Clearly berry skin with shallow uneven dimples, NOT a strawberry costume, not pointy wizard hat, no floating vines.

Restrained bronze, charcoal and dull turquoise; no teeth, no leaf cap, no red fruit, no detached chains, no extra limbs, no halo.

battles.name: 荆棘莓童
battles.prompt: Use case: compositing. Produce a 9:16 vertical dark fairytale battle concept. Image 1 is the approved scene to preserve, image 2 is the exact enemy design. Remove ALL THREE old mushroom enemies from image 1 and restore the ground. Insert exactly ONE full character from image 2 on the right, facing LEFT toward Red Riding Hood. Keep the heroine, her red cloak, lantern-scythe, pose and size, cabin, moon, creek, trees and camera composition unchanged. Place enemy center at 73% canvas width, feet at 75% height, top of cap including spikes at 54% height; target total enemy height 21% canvas and width 35% canvas, comparable to the heroine. All feet on dry same foreground groundline, natural contact shadow. Preserve exact cap material and uncanny motifs of image 2, short arms and feet, no extra limbs, no redesign, do not mirror to face right. Match scene's painted ink-contour style, soft cool moonlight with restrained warm lantern highlights. Do not make enemy too dark. No UI, no text, no additional characters or enemy group. This is a concept composite.
